name: OsciSynth Type 465 — Further Research (artist-inspired), FRONT-END-first
note: Artist-inspired front-end synth patches. Combined-patches with a real synth block; EQ light/optional. Agent-authored from research, UNTESTED by ear.

artistNotes.INZO: INZO (Mike Inzano) is a Chicago-based electronic producer/DJ working in psychedelic midtempo bass, wonky/experimental melodic bass and future bass, defined by trippy evolving textures and euphoric synth blooms. His Alan Watts-sampling breakout "Overthinker" (2018) is his signature record and a festival staple. Popularity: a mainstay of the festival-psychedelic bass circuit with roughly 650K+ Spotify monthly listeners, and "Overthinker" sits well past 100M streams.
artistNotes.Alleycvt: Profiled ALLEYCVT (the "ALLEYCAT?" the owner meant) — a rising US bass/dubstep producer-DJ out of Northern Virginia. Genre/affiliation: heavy + psychedelic dubstep and pop-driven melodic bass; she pairs sultry, siren-like pop vocals with dirty "bassface" growls (self-cited influences: Zeds Dead, Subtronics, Ganja White Night). Popularity: broke out from her 2022 single "Electric Shock" (~5.2M Spotify streams in 2023), grew her wonky-bass process on TikTok, and in ~3 years went to selling out headline tours and playing EDC Las Vegas, Lost Lands, Shambhala & Elements; debut EP "9 LIVES" dropped Sept 2025. The cute-vs-heavy contrast (siren topline over gnarly growl) is her core signature.
artistNotes.What So Not: What So Not is the Australian experimental future-bass / trap project of Emoh Instead (Christopher Emerson), originally co-founded with Flume before going solo in 2015; releasing via OWSLA, Sweat It Out and Counter Records, its sound pairs orchestral/organic emotion with gnarly wonky bass and huge hybrid drops. A festival mainstay (Coachella, Ultra, Lollapalooza) that charted on the Triple J Hottest 100 and Australian Singles Chart (Gemini #52), with multi-million-streaming signatures like Jaguar, Gemini, High You Are, Tell Me (w/ RL Grime) and the 2018 debut LP Not All the Beautiful Things.
artistNotes.Mr. Carmack: Aaron Carmack — LA-based (via San Francisco and Oahu) beatmaker and a pillar of the Soulection / Team Supreme beat-scene collectives, also in jazzy trio Jefferson Park Boys and club duo Project Paradis. Genre: genre-blurring experimental hip-hop, trap and future-beats built on gritty, distorted, off-kilter bass and inventive sound design, with a downtempo jazzy R&B side. Popularity: a cult pioneer with a near-track-a-week output who has quietly shaped a whole generation of beatmakers, pulling hundreds of thousands of monthly listeners despite staying largely underground.
artistNotes.Lane 8: Lane 8 is the alias of American producer/DJ Daniel Goldstein, a flagship name in melodic/deep/progressive house and founder of the This Never Happened (TNH) label (he rose via Anjunadeep). Hugely popular: millions of monthly Spotify listeners and sold-out global "phones-down" This Never Happened tours, making him one of the most-streamed and influential acts in the modern melodic-house scene.
artistNotes.Hamdi: Hamdi (Alexander Hamdi) is an Oxford-born, London-based UK bass producer signed to Zeds Dead's Deadbeats label, working across 140/deep dubstep, grime, UKG and bassline with weighty sound-system subs and gnarly wonky mids. His 2022 track "Skanka" became a modern dubstep classic and his 2024 Skrillex collab "Push" was one of the year's biggest dance records, taking him to Coachella main stages with support from Skrillex, Fred again.., Zeds Dead and Porter Robinson.
artistNotes.GANZ: GANZ (Jordy Saamena) is a Dutch (Amsterdam) future-bass/trap producer and Quality Goods Records (QGR, UZ's label) associate who also dropped his debut EP 'Skin In The Game' on Dim Mak (2018). A cult-favorite, critically-praised 'beatmaker' known for wonky, chopped/glitchy yet lush and playful sound design (Serum/Massive/Synplant + heavy resampling and vocal chops) rather than a chart-topping mainstream act -- respected inside the future-bass/experimental-bass scene for euphoric dreamy breaks colliding with gnarly hip-hop-weight drops.
artistNotes.QUIX: QUIX (Jonathan Schnell) is a New Zealand-born, LA-based producer and one of the defining figures of hybrid/wonky trap and bass music, releasing on Steve Aoki's Dim Mak (debut EP 'Heaps Cool' 2017, breakout 'Illusions' EP 2018) plus Mad Decent and Fool's Gold. Known for glossy-to-heavy, cinematic-melodic drops (collabs with Alison Wonderland on 'Time' and Vincent on 'Hero'), his tracks have racked up tens of millions of streams and festival main-stage play, and his two Splice sample packs made him a go-to reference for hybrid-trap sound design.
artistNotes.Skrillex: Sonny John Moore, aka Skrillex — American DJ/producer and the defining figure of US brostep (the aggressive, mainstream-crossover strain of dubstep); formerly lead vocalist of post-hardcore band From First to Last before going solo in 2007. His 2010 EP 'Scary Monsters and Nice Sprites' is widely credited with birthing brostep outright. Popularity: the most-decorated electronic artist in Grammy history (9 wins from 17 nominations) and one of Spotify's most-streamed EDM artists; his 2023 single 'Rumble' (with Fred again.. and Flowdan) became a global festival staple with 140M+ Spotify streams.

presets.name: Drip Reese
presets.sonicGoal: Core wide, melodic-gnarly reese; near-detuned X/Y axes beat against each other for movement instead of an LFO, played mid-low register.

presets.name: Flutter Wobble Sub
presets.sonicGoal: The rounded, 'fluttering' wobble sub under the flashier mids; lean on fmDepth for the womp and heavy smoothing so it reads as sub weight, not grit.

presets.name: Hoover Rave Stab
presets.sonicGoal: Nods to his 90s jungle/rave heritage; the Hoover/rave-stab flavor with PWM-style shimmer, stabbed rhythmically or pitch-ridden.

presets.name: Kaleidoscope Arp
presets.sonicGoal: Explosive, 8-bit-tinged psychedelic lead defining his melodic side; continuous rotZ/rotX spin gives the kaleidoscope motion, great arpeggiated or as a plucky topline.

presets.name: Miles-Deep Drone
presets.sonicGoal: The 'miles-deep atmosphere' bed / intro pad that sits under everything; the chaotic attractor gives it other-worldly, never-repeating evolution.

presets.name: Womp Talker
presets.sonicGoal: Talky, screeching mid-siren growl; morph swept by hand for the vowel/womp 'wob-wob' cadence, resample and re-pitch for extra character.

presets.name: Gargle Growl
presets.sonicGoal: The angry, talking counterpart to the squelch - fast FM flutter plus fold drive fakes the Serum vowel-filter growl.

presets.name: Gooey Reese
presets.sonicGoal: Detuned low-end bed where two axes beat against each other to form the reese - his gooey, phasing sub-bass foundation.

presets.name: Melodic Haze
presets.sonicGoal: His melodic-ambient side - an evolving chaotic-attractor texture that never repeats, slow and lush.

presets.name: Rubber Sub
presets.sonicGoal: Clean, fat underpinning so the squelch and growl layers can be gritty on top - minimal harmonics, no dirt.

presets.name: Talking Squelch
presets.sonicGoal: His signature wet vocal squelch - the hollow torus tube gives the 'ooo-wah' with a deep FM wub pulse.

presets.name: Wonk Pluck
presets.sonicGoal: Playful, slightly out-of-tune plucked lead riding over the bass - non-integer harmonics give the detuned wonk.

presets.name: Blue Collar Reese
presets.sonicGoal: The workhorse low wobble under a drop - fat, gritty, moving detuned reese; morph drifts up across the bar for growl life.

presets.name: Comedy Chaos FX
presets.sonicGoal: The extraterrestrial, cartoonish riser/transition - strange-attractor chaos with swinging 3D beam for the comedic 'what is that' moment before a drop.

presets.name: Extraterrestrial Transform Growl
presets.sonicGoal: Technique #5 as its own patch: a single held growl kept morphing/gurgling by swinging the 3D beam (rotX/rotY/rotZ + zoom) through the shape instead of layering resamples.

presets.name: Machine-Gun Tearout
presets.sonicGoal: The chaotic tearout scream for peak-drop moments - blown-out, screechy, machine-gun stutter; gate/chop it rhythmically.

presets.name: Swamp Sub
presets.sonicGoal: The fat Southern-swamp foundation that sits under the growls - round, dark, mono; layer directly beneath Blue Collar Reese.

presets.name: Taboo Talkbox Growl
presets.sonicGoal: His signature mouthy, gurgling growl - morph swept per note reads as a vowel/formant 'talking' sweep; dynamic bell honks in sympathy.

presets.name: Wonky Gear Bounce
presets.sonicGoal: The playful, drummer-brained bounce line - hypotrochoid gear-mesh gives a rubbery wonky character; groove sections between drops.

presets.name: Comb Screech Lead
presets.sonicGoal: The extraterrestrial screech/scream used as tension stabs and transitions; razor-bright, combed, hissing.

presets.name: Dread Intro Drone
presets.sonicGoal: The horror-film intro/bridge bed; evolving, eerie, unresolved. Strange-attractor motion keeps it from looping obviously.

presets.name: Exile Wonky Growl
presets.sonicGoal: The gnarly, rhythmic drop growl; superformula bloom folded into a metallic wonky snarl for the heaviest sections.

presets.name: Ghost Planet Sub
presets.sonicGoal: Cavernous half-time foundation, deliberately sterile/clean so the metallic growls sit on top without mud.

presets.name: Occult Reese
presets.sonicGoal: The detuned, phasing mid-bass ATLiens ride under drops; interference beating on the two axes IS the reese.

presets.name: Talking Alien Growl
presets.sonicGoal: Signature 'talking' bass; morph rides the vowel/mouth axis for call-and-response phrases (0.2->0.8, midpoint captured static).

presets.name: Anime Glitter FX
presets.sonicGoal: The reserved lorenz/heavy-jitter glitter one-shot from his palette — shimmering neon FX with a chaotic sparkle tail, used sparingly for accent.

presets.name: Chrome Growl
presets.sonicGoal: Crunchy-yet-controlled designer growl; spiky hyperstar + FM wobble, smoothing the leash that keeps it articulate.

presets.name: Colour Bloom Lead
presets.sonicGoal: Superformula's blooming, chord-driven brightness; ride morph with the melody for vivid evolving spectral motion.

presets.name: Glass Snap Pluck
presets.sonicGoal: Sparkling transient-snap colour-bass pluck; maximum cleanliness, zero drive, bloom on each hit for chord-driven drops.

presets.name: Kosher Sub
presets.sonicGoal: Clean weighty rounded sub (nods to his QGR single 'Kosher'); fundamental-heavy, brickwalled low end to sit under the reese and plucks.

presets.name: Neon Vowel Reese
presets.sonicGoal: Flagship clean, vocal, moving colour-bass 'designer' reese; co-prime harmonics make it sing not buzz, morph rides the vowel.

presets.name: Prism Detune
presets.sonicGoal: Braided helix supersaw-style reese; slow FM phases the two strands like a wide detune instead of warbling.

presets.name: Fighter Pilot Growl
presets.sonicGoal: The dark, aerodynamic Gud Vibrations-style growl ('Fighter Pilot'): bright metallic FM tube with fast neck-warble movement.

presets.name: Glitch Riddim Talkbox
presets.sonicGoal: His signature glitchy, vocal-like 'talking' future-riddim bass; morph opens/closes the vowel, jitter adds bleep-bloop dirt.

presets.name: Hive Sub
presets.sonicGoal: Clean subterranean foundation sitting under the growls and talkbox layers; near-sine, dark, mono, no motion.

presets.name: Leo Chaos FX
presets.sonicGoal: Strange-attractor chaos = his fast, glitchy experimental fills and pre-drop transitions; heavy jitter, fast rotation, sweeping pitch.

presets.name: Meteor Reese
presets.sonicGoal: Early QGR 'Meteor'-era detuned reese: the lissajous web is two beating detuned saws sweeping across the bar.

presets.name: Resampled Fold Bass
presets.sonicGoal: Fakes his resample-through-distortion stack: heavy wavefolder drive blooms new upper harmonics, smoothing kept low-mid to stay bright but controlled, jitter for grit.

presets.name: Visions Wonky Lead
presets.sonicGoal: The melodic color-bass lead - aggressive yet singing, the 'beauty and bass' half of Visions Of The Leo.

presets.name: Chaos Grit FX
presets.sonicGoal: Strange-attractor chaos - resample-ready source for risers, impacts, and glitchy transition FX in his 'Tybrid' style.

presets.name: OKC Tearout Screamer
presets.sonicGoal: The 'unlistenable-boys' tearout screech - drive and harmonics pushed to the ceiling, let it distort.

presets.name: Tybrid Metalmouth
presets.sonicGoal: Flagship riddim growl - spiro gear-mesh metal; fold drive + slow rotation make it snarl and 'talk'.

presets.name: Tybrid Sub
presets.sonicGoal: Deliberately boring - the tight anchor under Metalmouth/Screamer; drive and jitter at zero so the low end never distorts.

presets.name: Voidless Reese
presets.sonicGoal: Named for his QGR release 'Voidless' - the slow beating interference web IS the reese movement.

presets.name: Wonky Robot Lead
presets.sonicGoal: The 'Tybrid' melodic side - detuned, robotic, slightly off-kilter over half-time drums.

presets.name: Chrome Reese
presets.sonicGoal: Workhorse Oski reese - beating dual-axis detune plus fold grit for the evolving, gritchy chrome reese. Automate morph/fmDepth across a bar.

presets.name: Clockwork Pluck
presets.sonicGoal: The mechanical plucks and darting off-kilter melodies - odd 5:7 clang ratios, snappy draw. Sequence in odd rhythms; octave up for a bright bell-lead.

presets.name: Colossus Sub
presets.sonicGoal: Clean colossal sub foundation under the gritty top layers - fundamental-heavy tube, dark and round. Pair one-to-one under Chrome Reese or Kid Chrome Growl.

presets.name: Diabolical Drone
presets.sonicGoal: The diabolical synth atmosphere under intros and transitions - chaotic, never-looping lorenz texture with drifting rotation. Automate zoom/persp for rising-tension builds.

presets.name: In Check Wobble
presets.sonicGoal: The wobbles-with-sheer-intensity riddim bass - deep tempo-matched FM wobble plus ribbon flip motion. Sync fmRate to 1/4 or 1/8 and automate fmDepth per note.

presets.name: Kid Chrome Growl
presets.sonicGoal: The aggressive, face-melting Killa-era growl - max chrome fold grit plus high harmonic stacking. Retrigger fmRate for talky/gully articulation.

presets.name: Gold Mask Reese
presets.sonicGoal: Classic detuned metallic reese — the two beam axes acting as drifting detuned oscillators; morph is the mouth for vowel/talking movement in a drop.

presets.name: Kinetic Metal Perc
presets.sonicGoal: Original metallic percussion / clangs in the Kinetic Metal spirit — inharmonic ratios give the un-tuned metal ring; retrigger for hat/perc detailing and top-of-drop accents.

presets.name: Lo-Fi VHS Grime Pad
presets.sonicGoal: Extra patch implied by his VHS-degraded lo-fi grime technique on an evolving source — crawling JITTER dropout dirt against worn-tape SMOOTHING rolloff, slow morph and rotation so the degradation creeps over an evolving super texture.

presets.name: QGR Wonky Growl
presets.sonicGoal: The gnarly, wonky growl for a QGR-style drop — morph is the mouth; keep the pattern sparse and let the growl be the statement, true to his minimal-but-technical ethos.

presets.name: Sinister Designed Lead
presets.sonicGoal: The menacing, hand-designed hook lead — trippy and glitchy but minimal; the single foreground element while space carries the rest.

presets.name: Sub Circle (1:1)
presets.sonicGoal: Extra patch implied by his lissajous-1:1 clean-sub technique — an alternate engulfing 808 body traced as a near-sine circle, even darker and smoother than the torus version for pure sub weight.

presets.name: Trap Shit 808
presets.sonicGoal: Engulfing sub-forward 808 foundation — his 808 Warfare go-to as a pure traced sine with a hint of grit on the transient and a subtle 808 pitch-tail glide.

presets.name: VHS Attractor Drone
presets.sonicGoal: Ominous, room-filling atmosphere channeling his REAKTOR VHS Audio Degradation textures — chaotic, evolving, degraded; sits under drops or bridges the minimal sections.

presets.name: Cinematic Saga Drone
presets.sonicGoal: His cinematic, like a saga, very visual introspective side - the peaceful nite half of the name. Braided helix + slow 3D motion = an evolving drone/riser bed under the heavy sections.

presets.name: Excision Screamer
presets.sonicGoal: The Datsik/Excision super-robotic idol sound - lorenz chaos + fast FM + heavy fold = a screaming vowel growl you chop rhythmically.

presets.name: Hardnite Designer Hit
presets.sonicGoal: The perfectly distorted HARD Recs designer bass - spiky hyperstar geometry + max fold + jitter = gnarly one-shot hits you resample and pitch across a hybrid-trap pattern.

presets.name: Low-End Mastermind (Sub)
presets.sonicGoal: Layer this CLEAN sub under the distorted torus/lorenz bass so his low end stays tight and system-safe while the growl lives above it - his low-end mastermind reputation is built on this separation.

presets.name: Metallic Reese (Nite Crawl)
presets.sonicGoal: His bread-and-butter thick metallic reese - detune the two audio axes for the beat, elevate zHarm for the metal, keep motion slow so it crawls the way he describes seeing sound morph.

presets.name: Synaesthesia Ribbon
presets.sonicGoal: His literal synaesthesia - metal bending and morphing - as a wonky lead. The mobius ribbon + morph automation is the visual bending; use for hooks and topline stabs.

presets.name: Brute Growl
presets.sonicGoal: Chewy, talking, riddim-leaning growl — metallic buzzing tube with vocal-growl FM LFO ridden to the halftime groove; light dynamic notch tames the honking mid peak.

presets.name: Church Pad (Lush Drone)
presets.sonicGoal: The lush half of Tsuruda's duality — sad/church-pad warmth to sit under the grime; drive near off, high smoothing, low harmonics, long envelope, very slow evolving bloom.

presets.name: Deathwish Wonky Lead
presets.sonicGoal: Retro-videogame, weird-and-wonky lead — chirpy fast-draw motion with warbling FM and glitchy jitter; morph snapshot at the mid of its 0.2→0.8 phrase automation.

presets.name: Metallic Spike Mid
presets.sonicGoal: Spiky, bright Corpus-style metallic mid-bass to layer over Slimepunk Reese; slow wonk wobble, buzzy fold drive, dynamic EQ ducks the harsh 2–4kHz spike when stacked.

presets.name: Slimepunk Chaos FX
presets.sonicGoal: Experimental, weird resampled-glitch FX/riser — strange-attractor scatter with unstable slimey jitter, fast metallic FM sidebands, and tumbling rotation.

presets.name: Slimepunk Reese
presets.sonicGoal: Core Tsuruda wonky reese — grimy, swaggering, always moving; non-locking harmonic interference web with slow FM detune-beat.

presets.name: Auckland Reese
presets.sonicGoal: A wide, twisting reese with slow phasing movement — darker and rounder than the growl, mud carved out so it layers cleanly under the drop while keeping a gritty upper edge.

presets.name: Dim Mak Stab
presets.sonicGoal: A rich, plucky cinematic stab for chord hits and the pre-drop rhythm — bright and layered with a fast decay, driven just enough to add hybrid-trap grit.

presets.name: Heaps Cool Sub
presets.sonicGoal: The deep, pure sub anchor under the wonky drop — heavily smoothed to a near-sine with just a whisper of saturation for 808 warmth, band-limited so it never fights the growl.

presets.name: Hero Lead
presets.sonicGoal: A spiky, buzzy top-line screech lead for the hard drop — bright and cutting with high harmonics and FM bite, with a dynamic de-harsh so the 5k spikes stay musical at full drive.

presets.name: Illusions Growl
presets.sonicGoal: The core QUIX drop weapon: a chaotic, metallic wonky-trap growl with FM wobble and wavefolder grit — snarling midrange movement that sits over a sub, tamed dynamically so the screech never turns harsh.

presets.name: Mirage Riser
presets.sonicGoal: The chaotic build-up FX — a thin, high-tension screech riser with heavy FM wobble and noise jitter that spirals up into the drop, sitting above the low end so it reads as pure tension.

presets.name: Time Aurora
presets.sonicGoal: The glossy, emotional side of QUIX — a slow-blooming cinematic pad with subtle FM shimmer and airy top, for the melodic build/intro before the drop lands.

presets.name: Dream Break Pad
presets.sonicGoal: Lush, dreamy chord pad for the euphoric intros and breaks -- slow-blooming, other-worldly and warm, high smoothing for a clean rounded wash that contrasts the gnarly drop.

presets.name: Glitch Riser FX
presets.sonicGoal: Chaotic glitchy texture/riser -- noisy, fast-scanning and unstable via the Lorenz attractor plus heavy jitter and FM, the wonky scratches and weird transition effects that bridge GANZ's sections.

presets.name: Playful Chop Stab
presets.sonicGoal: Chopped/glitchy vocal-chop-style stab -- bright, bouncy and playful, short and rhythmic so it can be sliced and re-sequenced into wonky melodic hooks the way GANZ chops pop/R&B snippets.

presets.name: Screamer Lead
presets.sonicGoal: Gnarly metallic lead for high-energy drops -- bright, buzzy and screamy with FM movement and drive, cutting over the mix for the intense hooks in GANZ's drops.

presets.name: Sub Foundation
presets.sonicGoal: Clean, deep sub to sit under the growl -- near-sine, heavily smoothed and dark with no grit, providing the hip-hop low-end weight without clashing with the wonky mids.

presets.name: Talkbox Wonk Bass
presets.sonicGoal: A twisting, talking wonk-bass variant -- mobius-fold formant movement with FM wobble and drive, the vowel-like 'wow' bass that gives GANZ drops their playful, vocalized character.

presets.name: Wonky Growl
presets.sonicGoal: Signature wonky future-bass growl -- a thick, detuned reese that wobbles and honks under the drop, gnarly but musical, the hip-hop-weight low end GANZ collides with his dreamy breaks.

presets.name: Beautiful Things Bloom
presets.sonicGoal: The tender orchestral/organic side of the hybrid sound - a lush superformula bloom smoothed into a soft detuned future-bass chord with slow shimmer and a long emotive tail.

presets.name: Cataclysm FX Riser
presets.sonicGoal: The chaotic wonky transition/impact FX before a drop - a lorenz strange-attractor screaming through fast FM and heavy jitter, driven and pitch-unstable for tension.

presets.name: Divide Sub
presets.sonicGoal: Deep, round, near-sine trap sub for the low end under the drop - clean lissajous circle, heavily smoothed and band-limited so it stays pure weight.

presets.name: Gemini Reese Drop
presets.sonicGoal: Wide detuned reese for the big emotive drop - slowly beating mobius harmonics with just enough drive to bite, warm and moving rather than harsh.

presets.name: Jaguar Wonky Growl
presets.sonicGoal: The signature metallic wonky growl that anchors the hybrid drops - a chaotic, wobbling, throat-y torus bass that snarls and re-pitches under FM modulation, gnarly but musical.

presets.name: Not All Beautiful Drone
presets.sonicGoal: Evolving orchestral/organic drone-pad for intros and breakdowns - a slow-drawing helix that swells over seconds, smoothed and gently jittered so it breathes like strings under the electronics.

presets.name: Tell Me Metal Lead
presets.sonicGoal: Piercing gnarly hybrid lead that cuts over the drop - spiky hyperstar packed with high harmonics, driven and barely smoothed, with a touch of FM movement and grit.

presets.name: 808 Sub Weight
presets.sonicGoal: Round, pure, weighty sub with just a touch of wavefolder warmth for that saturated 808 body — heavy smoothing keeps it clean and focused under the beat.

presets.name: Carmack Reese Growl
presets.role: Signature gritty distorted growl / reese bass
presets.sonicGoal: Aggressive, off-kilter low-mid growl — torus ring detune beating driven hard through the wavefolder with a fast FM wobble for that snarling, moving Carmack bass.

presets.name: Evolving Drone Bloom
presets.sonicGoal: Slow-blooming superformula drone with a long attack/release, gentle FM drift and light drive texture — an ambient, evolving bed for the cinematic intros and interludes in Carmack's projects.

presets.name: Glitch Circuit FX
presets.sonicGoal: Chaotic, circuit-bent noise burst — Lorenz attractor with high jitter, deep fast FM and heavy drive for the distorted, glitchy transition FX and mangled textures Carmack litters through his beats.

presets.name: Metallic Bell Pluck
presets.sonicGoal: Angular, inharmonic cube pluck with FM for a clangy metallic bell tone — a fast-attacking, slightly detuned melodic stab for wonky top-line hooks and percussive accents.

presets.name: Sedate Jazz Keys
presets.sonicGoal: The introspective Carmack side — a rounded, warm spirograph key voice with heavy smoothing and almost no grit for lo-fi jazzy chords and mellow melodic beds.

presets.name: Wonky Off-Kilter Lead
presets.sonicGoal: Bright, buzzy, slightly detuned butterfly lead with non-integer harmonics for a microtonal, off-kilter Carmack melody line — a little drive and jitter keep it raw and human.

presets.name: 9 LIVES Growl
presets.sonicGoal: Her core bassface growl — a morphing, buzzy superformula bloom with a mid-tempo wobble and wavefolder grit, sitting in the classic Subtronics/GWN wonky-dubstep pocket. Metallic bite up top, tight and controllable low-mid.

presets.name: Bassface Dirt
presets.sonicGoal: The earth-shaking main-drop bass — spiky, hyper-buzzy and aggressive with a fast screaming wobble and heavy wavefolder distortion. The dirty-bass-face moment that makes the crowd pull the mug.

presets.name: Fall Into You Shimmer
presets.sonicGoal: The shimmering psychedelic synths behind the melodic/emotional sections (like the FALL INTO YOU atmosphere) — a slow-swelling spirograph drone that evolves gently, smoothed and airy with a top-end shimmer shelf.

presets.name: Laser Riser
presets.sonicGoal: The 'a LOT of lasers' transition FX — a fast, rising helix that screams upward with deep FM and jitter noise for a zappy laser tail. Drop it on build-ups and impacts.

presets.name: Nine Lives Sub
presets.sonicGoal: The pure, round sub under the growls — a fat torus with the harmonics pulled to near-fundamental and heavy lowpass smoothing so it's a clean, phone-safe sub with no buzz. Sits beneath Bassface Dirt / 9 LIVES Growl.

presets.name: Siren Topline
presets.sonicGoal: The cute half of the contrast — a smooth, rounded, vocal-ish siren lead with gentle vibrato that rides over the drops. Heavy smoothing tames the buzz into a pop-topline formant tone with a presence lift.

presets.name: Wonky Wobble
presets.sonicGoal: The TikTok wonky-bass wobble — a twisting mobius reese with a slower ~1/4-note FM wobble and moderate grit. Groovier and more playful than the main drop, the wonky filler between bassface hits.

presets.name: Bangarang Screech Lead 465
presets.styleRef: Skrillex — 'Bangarang'/'Kyoto' pitched metallic screech topline (nasal robot-voice lead)
presets.sonicGoal: A higher-register metallic screech-lead that talks: dense comb-like butterfly harmonics with a fast chatter motion and one resonant nasal 'EE' formant, sitting bright and biting above the growl as the topline.

presets.name: Clean Sub Anchor 465
presets.styleRef: Skrillex — layering rule: clean mono sub under the distorted growl/wobble mids
presets.sonicGoal: The felt-not-heard foundation beneath the mid growl: a pure, near-sine lissajous sub with almost no harmonics or buzz, band-limited to stay clean and mono so the distorted layers own everything above it.

presets.name: Equinox Scream 465
presets.styleRef: Skrillex — 'First of the Year (Equinox)' screaming hoover / acid drop-lead
presets.sonicGoal: The screaming acid/hoover drop-lead: dense high-harmonic spiro partials driven hard into the wavefolder with aggressive fast motion, bright and ice-pick nasty so it cuts through a full drop as the lead hook.

presets.name: Euphoria Bloom 465
presets.styleRef: Skrillex — euphoric melodic side ('First of the Year' melody / 'With You, Friends' drop chords)
presets.sonicGoal: The pretty, euphoric counterweight to the filth: a lush superformula bloom lead/chord with shimmering high partials, a slow morphing glow and gentle vibrato gloss, silky but still bright enough to soar over a drop.

presets.name: Half-Time Womp 465
presets.styleRef: Skrillex — classic half-time 'womp womp' LFO wobble bass (Scary Monsters verse wub)
presets.sonicGoal: The rounder, darker half-time wobble bass under the growl — a deep, slow eighth-note womp with warm folded harmonics, thick low body and a tamed top so it grooves rather than shreds.

presets.name: Metal Riser Impact 465
presets.styleRef: Skrillex — transition FX: metallic risers, glitch noise beds and pre-drop impacts
presets.sonicGoal: A metallic build-FX bed: chaotic lorenz turbulence with a heavy jitter noise wash and a slow swelling envelope, set at the static midpoint of an 'opening up' sweep so it reads as a rising whoosh/impact tail into the drop.

presets.name: Tearout Larynx 465
presets.styleRef: Skrillex — 'Scary Monsters'/'Kill Everybody' hard metallic tearout growl bass
presets.sonicGoal: The signature Skrillex tearout growl: a violent, metallic, fast-articulating mid-forward bass built from dense inharmonic partials and hard wavefolder grit, scooped low-mid with a spiky 2 kHz bite and the ice-pick top leashed only when it spikes.

presets.name: Astral Drone
presets.sonicGoal: A long, metallic Mobius drone that slowly rotates and morphs - the meditative undercurrent bed for psychedelic build sections and intros.

presets.name: Festival Riser FX
presets.sonicGoal: A chaotic, evolving riser texture built on Lorenz chaos - swells up with airy noise and fast wobble to launch a drop, the trippy transition glue.

presets.name: Overthinker Growl
presets.sonicGoal: The core 'Overthinker'-style wonky bass: a detuned metallic reese with a rhythmic pitch/formant wobble, gritty but musical, sitting fat in the low-mids for festival midtempo.

presets.name: Psychonaut Lead
presets.sonicGoal: A bright, buzzy trip-lead with a slow wobble baked in - psychedelic and vocal-like, cuts through the mix without going harsh.

presets.name: Trippy Bloom Pad
presets.sonicGoal: The euphoric 'synth bloom' that opens up behind the vocal/Watts sample - a slow-blooming, shimmering superformula pad that evolves as it sustains.

presets.name: Watts Sub
presets.sonicGoal: A rounded, near-sine sub to sit under the growl and dreamy pads - dark, clean, no grit, the weight beneath the atmosphere.

presets.name: Wonky Pluck
presets.sonicGoal: A short, bouncy melodic pluck for the future-bass side of INZO - bright and springy with a touch of wonk, good for arpeggiated hooks.

presets.name: Brightest Lights Pad
presets.sonicGoal: Warm, ethereal evolving pad that swells slowly with a long tail. Low harmonics + very high smoothing keep it lush and non-aggressive; a whisper of FM and jitter adds gentle analog drift.

presets.name: Fingerprint Bell
presets.sonicGoal: Soft FM bell / keys for melodic motifs and vocal-chop-style stabs. Higher harmonics plus moderate FM give inharmonic bell overtones; medium smoothing keeps sparkle without harshness, with a gentle bell decay.

presets.name: Hypnotic Roller Lead
presets.sonicGoal: A clean, hypnotic melodic lead that sits on top of the mix without harshness. Lissajous curves give a near-sine core; a small drive and subtle FM shimmer let it cut, medium smoothing keeps it musical.

presets.name: Little By Little Bass
presets.sonicGoal: Soft, rounded rolling melodic bass — never a heavy Reese. Minimal harmonics and heavy smoothing keep it round and warm; a light high-cut removes any metallic buzz so it glues under the pads.

presets.name: Phones Down Pluck
presets.sonicGoal: The signature warm, rolling FM pluck (Atlas / No Fun): bell-tinged, syncopated, brassy but soft. High smoothing tames the synth's metallic edge while a touch of FM gives the bell attack.

presets.name: This Never Happened (Atmos)
presets.sonicGoal: A slowly evolving warm drone/texture for intros and breakdowns. Mobius gives continuous morphing motion; very slow draw + long attack/release and slow FM drift make it breathe. Jitter adds grainy air.

presets.name: Under-Current Sub
presets.sonicGoal: A clean, pure foundation sub. Pure fundamental (harmonics at 1), no FM, maximum smoothing and a steep high-cut so only round low-end energy remains under the track.

presets.name: Dark Room Drone
presets.sonicGoal: An evolving, unpredictable low drone for the dark noisy rooms Hamdi loves — chaotic slow-drifting texture that swells and encompasses the space between drops.

presets.name: Deep Half-Time Wobble
presets.sonicGoal: A deep, rounded half-time LFO wobble — slow rate for that lurching sound-system sway, dark and rolling with modest grit so it stays low and heavy rather than fizzy.

presets.name: Gnarly Grime Lead
presets.sonicGoal: A bright, metallic gnarly lead for grime-tinged 140 hooks — fast draw, FM edge and wavefolder grit giving an aggressive cutting top that still carries UK swagger.

presets.name: Skanka Riser FX
presets.sonicGoal: A tense metallic spiraling riser to build into the drop — fast-moving spiral with rotation, FM edge and jitter for a gritty upward-tension sweep.

presets.name: Skanka Sub Engine
presets.sonicGoal: A weighty, clean rolling sound-system sub that anchors a deep half-time drop — near-sine, pure and round with just enough drive to translate on club/festival rigs.

presets.name: Skanka Wonky Lead
presets.sonicGoal: The signature Hamdi rubbery, pitch-wobbled mid hook — squelchy and off-kilter with a skanking rhythmic bounce, gritty designed character sitting in the low-mid.

presets.name: Sound-System Reese
presets.sonicGoal: A gnarly, buzzy detuned reese growl with UK sound-system weight — bright spiky harmonics up top, grit-folded mids, slow movement so it churns under the drop.
